original_context_note: Compared spec.full_target, H001/H002, D001-D006 and D008 against problem.md:14-30 and 34-167. The ambient integer n≥0 is represented by a natural number, with n=0 retained throughout. H001 is precisely the explicitly approved nonemptiness addition in lines 16-23; H002 is the original compactness assumption. Neither a desired conclusion nor a proof claim was promoted to H. Both H are used: H002 in R002/S001 for boundedness and finite covers, H001 in R002/S002 for the singleton case and R006/S004 for x_0. No original H is unused. D001 fixes the closed unit interval; D002 fixes the Euclidean coordinate identification and its exact distance, not the sup product norm. D003/D004 preserve the unnormalized arbitrary-countable-cover formula, nonmeasurable cover members, positive exponents/scales and empty-member zero convention. D008 gives the native Hausdorff-measure operator and full covering formula. D005 is the native extended-nonnegative Hausdorff-dimension supremum definition; the read native definition at HausdorffDimension.lean:96-98 agrees, and the empty-set convention follows from empty covers. D006 defines D without assuming it finite; that property is proved by R002 before any finite-real use. All global definitions are total on their stated domains and require no missing construction guard. The auxiliary B in R002 is explicitly a total real-supremum expression and its bound property is proved, rather than assumed in a choice. The eight retained M sources were positively probed at the pinned commit, their full signatures and ordinary logical axioms inspected, and their actual native source contexts read: Hausdorff.lean:535-552, HausdorffDimension.lean:94-134, Lebesgue/Add.lean:354-367, OuterMeasure/Basic.lean:42-72 and Lebesgue/Basic.lean:85-96. Their NL contracts preserve the EMetricSpace, Borel measurable-space, NNReal exponent, AEMeasurable, Countable and OuterMeasureClass premises as applicable. M009 was an exploratory probe only, is not selected, and supplies no factual use in this proof. The original route is preserved in R002 (ambient bound), R003 (positive-diameter cover preparation and product partitions), R004 (open-interval enlargement and Tonelli slicing), R005 (s↑D), and R006 (length argument for the interval and its isometric copy). All needed constants, cost inequalities and limits from the supplied proof are retained. No material mathematical passage was omitted as optional. The graph has H/E/M-only roots (here no E is selected), one producer for each N/P, and all retained M/N lie in P's AND dependency closure. Structural success is not mathematical certification; these notes report my own actual packet inspection under the shared acceptance criteria.

output_notes.note: R001/S001 proves the exact positive-exponent identity Hmeasure=Hnative, including why the native infinite scale changes no supremum and why empty cover members agree. R001/S002 proves all four exported critical-exponent clauses, with the last clause following from the explicit supremum definition. The output quantifies X,A,s and contains the normalization bridge needed by every later dimension argument; no consumer needs the producer body.

R002/S001 establishes boundedness, finite covers at every δ>0 and finite cost for every s>0; R002/S002 supplies the mesh-h box calculation, D≤n, and the separate n=0 singleton proof using H001. Thus the full exported finiteness, real-identification and exceptional-case statements are justified, including the finite Hscale clause needed as the integration constant in R004.

R003/S001 proves the n=0 upper bound without using positive-diameter balls. S002 establishes existence of the required positive-diameter cover; S003 proves the exact 2(√2)^{q+1}ε cost bound at target scale δ; S004 first sends ε to zero, then takes the supremum over δ, and finally sends q down to finite D. The output is the unconditional upper bound hdim(F)≤D+1 in precisely the Euclidean metric.

R004 proves the scale-preserving inequality for every s>0 and δ>0, not only the exponents below D. S001 justifies c<∞, S002-S003 construct measurable open enlargements and the slice cover, S004 establishes c≤Σρ_i^{s+1}+ε, and S005 treats both finite and infinite cover cost before taking infima. The exported formula has both positive-range quantifiers and the same δ on each side, as required by R005.

R005/S001 turns N004 and the infinite Hmeasure(s,E) supplied by N001 into infinite Hmeasure(s+1,F), hence hdim(F)≥s+1 for every 0<s<D. S002 uses the explicitly supplied finite D from N002 to pass s↑D and closes D>0. The exact conditional output is retained, not asserted without its antecedent.

R006/S001-S003 proves hdim(I)=1 by both equal-length upper covers and the complete enlarged-interval length lower bound. S004 derives the cover-pullback inequality for the isometric map t↦(x_0,t), then obtains hdim(F)≥1 and, under the discharged D=0 antecedent, 1=D+1. The output covers n=0 and has no dependence on the private point x_0.

R007/S001 takes only N002,N003,N005,N006: nonnegative finite D has the exhaustive cases D>0 and D=0, each gives the lower bound, and N003 gives the upper bound. Antisymmetry and D=hdim(E) produce exactly spec.conclusion. D002 expands F to the original E×[0,1] with the specified Euclidean identification, so no endpoint, domain or norm conversion is suppressed.
